home.title: Unreal Studio Madrid | Real Estate Investments in Bali
home.heroBody: Earn up to 28% gross annual investing at developer cost alongside our in-house architecture studio in Bali.
home.section1Body: Tax and regulatory pressure keep eroding real estate yield in Europe. We give you access to emerging markets with higher potential and professional management.
home.section2Body: We cut intermediaries and optimise the full process. We design, develop and market assets below market, creating value from day one.
home.ctaSectionBody: Book a 30-minute meeting, no commitment. We assess your investor profile and show you real opportunities.
home.b1Body: Direct development prices, no inflated margins, optimising the risk-return ratio from the start.
home.b2Body: Structured processes, clear contracts and ongoing legal support so you invest with greater peace of mind.
home.b3Body: Protect your capital by accessing real estate in destinations with sustained growth and real demand.
home.v3Body: You buy at developer price. You capture the difference over market value.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.whoWeArePost: . At Unreal Studio we recognise the importance of protecting the privacy and rights of individuals in relation to their personal information. This document is our privacy policy and explains how we collect and manage your personal data.
privacy.controllerP: The data controller is Unreal Studio, the entity responsible for the real estate projects and services advertised through this website and for the associated advertising campaigns.
privacy.dataH: WHAT PERSONAL DATA WE COLLECT AND WHY
privacy.dataP1: We may collect your name, postal or physical address, email address, telephone number, age or date of birth, profession, occupation or job title, government identification data and any additional information related to you that you provide to us directly through our websites or indirectly through your use of our websites or online presence, through our representatives or in any other way, as well as information you provide to us through our customer service centre, satisfaction surveys or visits from our representatives.
privacy.dataP2: We may also collect information that is not personal because it does not identify you or anyone else. For example, we may collect anonymous survey responses or aggregated information about how users use our website.
privacy.purposeP: The personal data provided through forms, messages or advertising campaigns on social media will be used solely to:
purposeList: Provide information related to real estate projects
Carry out informative communications linked to our services
Improve our online products and services
Manage participation in contests, promotions or requests for information
privacy.collectH: HOW WE COLLECT YOUR PERSONAL INFORMATION
privacy.collectP1: We collect your personal information directly from you, unless it is unreasonable or impracticable to do so. The methods of collection include:
collectList1: Through your access to and use of our website
During conversations between you and our representatives
When participating in contests, promotions or requesting information
When completing surveys, providing feedback or filing complaints
privacy.collectP2: We may also collect personal information from third parties, including:
collectList2: Third-party companies such as credit reporting agencies, law enforcement bodies and government entities
Your representatives (lawyers, accountants and financial advisers)
Publicly available information sources or other organisations where you have given your consent
privacy.legitimacyP: The legal basis for processing the data is:
legitimacyList: The user's express consent, granted when submitting forms or initiating contact
The legitimate interest in maintaining and improving our services
privacy.cookiesP1: When you access our website, we may send a "cookie" (a small summary file containing a unique identification number) to your computer. This allows us to recognise your computer and track your activity on our website over a period of time.
privacy.cookiesP2: We also use cookies to measure traffic patterns, determine which areas of our website have been visited and measure transaction patterns in aggregate. We use this information to research our users' habits in order to improve our online products and services. Our cookies do not collect personal information.
privacy.cookiesP3: If you do not wish to receive cookies, you can configure your browser so that your computer does not accept them.
privacy.cookiesP4: We may record IP addresses (i.e. the electronic addresses of computers connected to the internet) to analyse trends, administer the website and track user movements.
privacy.embeddedP1: Articles on this site may include embedded content (for example, videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in exactly the same way as if the visitor had visited the other website.
privacy.embeddedP2: These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction if you have an account and are logged in to that website.
privacy.shareH: WHO WE SHARE YOUR DATA WITH
privacy.shareP1: We may disclose personal information to our related entities and to third-party suppliers and service providers located overseas for some of the purposes mentioned above. We take reasonable steps to ensure that the recipients of your personal information do not breach the privacy obligations relating to your personal information.
privacy.shareP2: The data will not be transferred to third parties, except where required by law.
privacy.retentionP1: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so that we can recognise and automatically approve any follow-up comments instead of holding them in a moderation queue.
privacy.retentionP2: For users who register on our website, we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can view, edit or delete their personal information at any time (except that they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also view and edit that information.
privacy.retentionP3: The data will be retained for as long as strictly necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected or for as long as a relationship of legitimate interest exists between the parties.
privacy.rightsP1: If you have an account on this site or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to retain for administrative, legal or security purposes.
privacy.rightsP2: The rights you may exercise at any time are:
privacy.rightsP3: To exercise these rights, please contact us through the contact channels provided.
privacy.complaintP1: If you believe your privacy has been breached, please contact us using the contact information set out below and provide details of the incident so that we can investigate it. We will handle the complaint in accordance with our current Complaints Management Procedure.
privacy.complaintP2: We will treat your requests or complaints confidentially. Our representative will contact you within a reasonable time after receiving your complaint to discuss your concerns and explain the options for how they can be resolved. We will ensure that your complaint is resolved in a timely and appropriate manner.
privacy.securityP1: Because our website is linked to the internet, and the internet is inherently insecure, we cannot provide any guarantee regarding the security of the transmission of information you communicate to us online. Nor can we guarantee that the information you provide to us will not be intercepted while being transmitted over the internet. Consequently, any personal or other information you transmit to us online is transmitted at your own risk.
privacy.securityP2: The data controller adopts the technical and organisational measures necessary to ensure the security and confidentiality of personal data.
privacy.changesP1: We may change this privacy policy from time to time. Any updated version of this privacy policy will be published on our website.
privacy.changesP2: This privacy policy was last updated on 5 February 2026.
privacy.contactP: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, any concerns or comments about how your privacy is handled, please use the contact link on our website or write to:
privacy.compliance: Regulatory compliance: This privacy policy complies with Reglamento (UE) 2016/679 (RGPD), Ley Orgánica 3/2018 de Protección de Datos Personales y garantía de los derechos digitales (LOPDGDD), and Meta's requirements for advertising campaigns.

instructions.title: How to clock in
items: When you arrive at your workplace (office, site, project, client or the first meeting of the day) tap Check-in and take a photo of the spot.
When you finish (leaving the office or the last site) tap Check-out and take another photo.
It takes 2 seconds: tap, photo, done. The time and location are saved automatically.
Usual hours 10:00–18:00. Do it every day you work (also Saturdays/Sundays if you go in).
